# Select the release build type by default to get optimization flags.
# This has to come before project() which otherwise initializes it.
# Build type can still be overridden by setting -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=
set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE
    "Release"
    CACHE STRING "")

########################################################################
# Project setup
########################################################################
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
# The module is pure Python. find_package(Gnuradio) needs a compiler language to locate its config files.
project(gr-serorx CXX C)
enable_testing()

# Install to PyBOMBS target prefix if defined
if(DEFINED ENV{PYBOMBS_PREFIX})
    set(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX
        $ENV{PYBOMBS_PREFIX}
        CACHE PATH "")
    message(
        STATUS
            "PyBOMBS installed GNU Radio. Defaulting CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX to $ENV{PYBOMBS_PREFIX}"
    )
endif()

# Find gnuradio to get access to the cmake modules
find_package(Gnuradio "3.10" REQUIRED)

# Set the version information here
# cmake-format: off
set(VERSION_MAJOR 0)
set(VERSION_API   7)
set(VERSION_ABI   0)
set(VERSION_PATCH 0)
# cmake-format: on

cmake_policy(SET CMP0011 NEW)

########################################################################
# Minimum Version Requirements
########################################################################

include(GrMinReq)

########################################################################
# Install directories
########################################################################
include(GrVersion)
include(GNUInstallDirs)

########################################################################
# Create uninstall target
########################################################################
configure_file(${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/cmake_uninstall.cmake.in
               ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cmake_uninstall.cmake @ONLY)

add_custom_target(uninstall ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -P
                            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cmake_uninstall.cmake)

########################################################################
# Add subdirectories
########################################################################
add_subdirectory(examples)
if(ENABLE_PYTHON)
    message(STATUS "PYTHON and GRC components are enabled")
    add_subdirectory(python/serorx)
    add_subdirectory(grc)
else(ENABLE_PYTHON)
    message(STATUS "PYTHON and GRC components are disabled")
endif(ENABLE_PYTHON)

install(FILES MANIFEST.yml
    RENAME MANIFEST-${VERSION_MAJOR}.${VERSION_API}.${VERSION_ABI}.${VERSION_PATCH}.yml
    DESTINATION share/gnuradio/manifests/serorx)

install(FILES LICENSE
    RENAME copyright
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DOCDIR})

########################################################################
# Debian package (cpack from a build configured with prefix /usr)
########################################################################
set(CPACK_GENERATOR DEB)
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_NAME gr-serorx)
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION "${VERSION_MAJOR}.${VERSION_API}.${VERSION_ABI}")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_CONTACT "Fabio Ramirez Stern <github@faramire.de>")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION_SUMMARY "GNU Radio source block for SeRo Systems GRX receivers")
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE all)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_DEPENDS "gnuradio (>= 3.10), python3 (>= 3.10), python3-grpcio, python3-protobuf (>= 3.20), python3-numpy")
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_SECTION hamradio)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_HOMEPAGE "https://github.com/SeRoSystems/gr-serorx")
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_FILE_NAME DEB-DEFAULT)
include(CPack)
